manual_prompt_templates.prompt: A dynamic realistic environmental waist-up lifestyle portrait of a clearly adult 22-23 year old mainland Chinese woman in a sunlit apartment living room with sheer curtains, green plant, sofa, coffee table, book stack, and readable background depth; not a plain white studio background. She has a beautiful modern East Asian Chinese clean-beauty face with a slim oval-melon facial outline, visible soft three-dimensional cheekbone and jaw planes, delicate cheek-to-jaw separation, fine willow brows, luminous lifted fox-almond eyes with strong catchlights looking back to camera, a refined straight high East Asian nose bridge, compact nostrils, and a compact flower-petal mouth. Cool-neutral white-and-pink Chinese fair skin, milk-fair translucent cheeks, bright side-window light, subtle cheekbone and nose-bridge highlights, gentle jawline shadow, fine natural pores without blemishes, no tan or beige-orange cast. Lips are almost-clear pale baby-pink transparent lip-balm only, bright and low-saturation, not red, not rose, not brown, not mauve, and not heavy lipstick. Natural long black hair with a believable scalp part, realistic hairline density, varied strand thickness, small uneven strand groups, fine baby hairs, light flyaways near the temples, mild natural frizz, and soft lived-in movement behind one shoulder. She wears a lightweight fitted pale peach square-neck top with thin structured fabric, fully dressed and tasteful like a fresh sensual art portrait, preserving a natural fuller upper-body silhouette, clear upper-body-to-waist contour through fabric, visible collarbone, visible waist cue, center torso visible from collarbone to waist, no thick sweater, no bulky cardigan, hands away from the torso, hair not covering the torso. Pose is a lively three-quarter waist-up moment, shoulders angled about 20 degrees, head slightly turned back toward camera, relaxed eye-smile, softly lifted mouth corners, open posture, natural hand tension, small clothing wrinkles, subtle facial asymmetry, real camera photograph, restrained retouching.
